svg.title: Figure 11.18: Productive and allocative efficiency in the short run in monopolistic competition
svg.desc: Two panels, abnormal profit and loss: in each the profit-maximising output q (MC = MR) differs from the productively efficient output q1 (MC = AC) and the allocatively efficient output q2 (MC = AR).
